messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a good wipe‑down, polish the finish, and tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Shoot from multiple angles (headstock, body, back, neck, bridge, electronics). Use natural light and a neutral background. | Great photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of returns. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, and local classifieds. Note price ranges for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Helps you set a realistic asking price and avoid over‑ or under‑pricing. | | **4. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes (e.g., “no cracks, minor fret wear”), and any extras (case, strap, picks). | Transparency builds trust and reduces back‑and‑forth. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music stores** – consignment or direct sale. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point can still land you a good deal. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local pickup** – no shipping costs, instant payment.
• **Shipping** – use a sturdy case, insurance, and trackable service. | Shipping adds cost and risk; local pickup is safer for high‑value instruments. | | **8. Prepare for Negotiation** | Be ready to answer questions about the guitar’s history, maintenance, and any repairs. | Prompt, honest answers speed the sale and reduce buyer hesitation. | | **9. Secure Payment** | • **Cash** – safest for local sales.
• **PayPal / Venmo** – secure for online sales.
• **Escrow** – for high‑value items. | Protects both parties and ensures you receive funds before handing over the guitar. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Sign a simple bill of sale (include serial number, price, date, and signatures). | Provides legal proof of ownership transfer and protects against disputes. | ### Quick Tips - **Avoid “too good to be true” offers** – if a buyer wants to pay more than your asking price but insists on a quick, cash‑only deal, proceed with caution. - **Use a protective case** – especially if shipping; it protects the guitar and shows you’re serious. - **Offer a return window** – a 48‑hour return policy can increase buyer confidence. - **Keep receipts** – if you’ve had recent repairs or upgrades, having documentation can justify a higher price. ### Example Listing (Reverb) > **Title:** 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Price:** $350 (Negotiable) > **Description:** > • Brand: Yamaha > • Model: FG800 > • Year: 2015 > • Condition: Minor fret wear, no cracks, fully functional electronics. > • Extras: Original case, strap, picks. > • Serial #: 123456789 > • Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 12‑string. > • Shipping: Will ship via UPS Ground with insurance. > • Local pickup available in [City]. > **Photos:** (Attach 8–10 clear images) > **Payment:** PayPal or Venmo. > **Return Policy:** 48‑hour return window if the guitar is not as described. > **Contact:** [Your Name] – [Phone] / [Email] --- **Final Thought:** The key to a successful sale is preparation and transparency. By presenting a clean, well‑documented instrument and choosing the right platform, you’ll attract serious buyers and close the deal faster. Good luck!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can provide steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local classifieds), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips, etc. Also mention potential for trade-in, consignment, or local music stores. Provide tips for negotiation, safe transaction, etc. No function call needed.
